evals.expected_output: Runs in observe mode (default), scans project state, reports recommended actions without executing
expectations: Defaults to observe mode when no --mode flag provided
Scans for triage branches, backlog items, WIP, and PRs
Presents a prioritized list of recommended actions
Does NOT invoke /implement, /plan, or /pr (observe only)

evals.expected_output: Starts autonomous SCAN-DECIDE-EXECUTE-EVALUATE loop, dispatches work to pipeline skills
expectations: Initializes session with budget and run log
Runs SCAN to analyze project state
Uses priority algorithm to DECIDE next action
Dispatches to /orchestrate, /implement, /plan, or /pr as appropriate
Evaluates results and loops or pauses

evals.expected_output: Alias for observe mode — shows what would happen without executing
expectations: Treats --dry-run as equivalent to --mode observe
Scans project state and reports recommended actions
Does NOT execute any pipeline skills

evals.expected_output: Starts autonomous loop with 120-minute time budget
expectations: Parses '2h' as 120 minutes
Displays budget in session initialization
Tracks elapsed time per cycle
Would stop gracefully when budget exhausted

evals.expected_output: Scans for triage branches and dispatches /plan or /triage only — no code implementation
expectations: Sets mode to triage-only
SCAN checks for triage branches and unplanned items
Dispatches only /plan or /triage skills
Does NOT invoke /implement or /pr
Pauses when no triage work remaining

evals.expected_output: Scans for open PRs and dispatches /pr review only — no code implementation
expectations: Sets mode to review-only
SCAN checks for PRs awaiting review
Dispatches only /pr skill for review
Does NOT invoke /implement or /plan
Pauses when no PRs to review

evals.expected_output: Starts full autonomy mode with auto-assign, auto-state, and auto-merge enabled within a 60-minute budget
expectations: Sets mode to full
Parses '1h' as 60 minutes
Enables auto-assign for unassigned items
Enables auto-state to sync tracker state after each cycle
Enables auto-merge for approved PRs with passing checks
All enforcement gates still checked normally

evals.expected_output: Starts implement mode tracking both time budget and a 500k token budget
expectations: Parses '500k' as 500000 tokens
Sets autopilot.budget.tokens to 500000
Tracks token consumption in autopilot.budget.tokensUsed
Displays token budget alongside time budget in session initialization
Would stop gracefully when either budget exhausted

evals.expected_output: Resumes the most recent paused autopilot session with a summary of previous state
expectations: Reads previous session from session-state.json
Displays resume summary with previous session ID, elapsed time, and pause reason
Sets autopilot.previousSessionId to the resumed-from session ID
Continues from where the previous session left off
Inherits mode and remaining budget from previous session

evals.expected_output: Starts implement mode with per-cycle self-improvement analysis after each SCAN-DECIDE-EXECUTE-EVALUATE cycle
expectations: Sets autopilot.selfImprovement.level to 'per-cycle'
After each cycle, runs analysis phase collecting observations
Stores observations in autopilot.selfImprovement.observations
Proposes or applies improvements based on analysis
Tracks improvements in autopilot.selfImprovement.improvementsApplied

evals.expected_output: Starts implement mode with self-improvement analysis deferred to session end
expectations: Sets autopilot.selfImprovement.level to 'end-of-session'
Does NOT run analysis between cycles
At session end, performs comprehensive analysis collecting observations
Stores observations in autopilot.selfImprovement.observations
Proposes improvements in autopilot.selfImprovement.improvementsProposed

evals.expected_output: Starts implement mode with experiment mode enabled, using dual-implementation comparison for dispatches
expectations: Sets autopilot.experiment to true
Validates mode is implement or full (experiment only valid in those modes)
Uses dual-approach protocol when dispatching /implement
Compares implementation approaches before selecting final
References experiment-mode.md for protocol details

evals.expected_output: Starts implement mode scanning across TH and F3 projects
expectations: Parses comma-separated project keys into autopilot.scopedProjects array
Runs SCAN phase for each project (TH and F3)
Merges scan results into a combined state summary
Uses round-robin or priority-based dispatch across projects
References cross-project.md for combined scan protocol

evals.expected_output: Starts implement mode with 2-hour budget and displays session history trends from previous runs
expectations: Reads doc/autopilot/history.json during session initialization
Displays trend summary from last 3 sessions (avg cycles, items/session, duration)
Sets autopilot.historyPath to doc/autopilot/history.json
On session end, appends session summary to history.json
Commits history.json alongside the run log
